title: Enterprise analytics onramp and service banding for high-volume requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Enterprise customers are increasingly submitting ad-hoc and large-scale telemetry requests (usage exports, cross-tenant cost breakdowns, multi-month retention snapshots) that current self-serve flows don't handle well. These requests create a lot of churn for SEs and Eng and risk SLA breaches when they are misrouted.

Problem: No clear onramp or eligibility matrix to separate low-effort self-serve asks from high-effort, high-touch deliverables. As a result: long lead times, unclear cost attribution, repetitive scoping conversations, and missed SLAs.

Goal: Define a defensible service-banding model and routing playbook for console & reporting requests that: 1) funnels routine analytics to self-serve tooling, 2) identifies high-touch enterprise requests early and routes them to a concierge lane with explicit SLOs and cost estimates, and 3) surfaces billing/commitment triggers to Sales/CS to convert to Dedicated or Professional Services when appropriate.

Proposed solution summary:
- Create a triage questionnaire (web form + templated Slack intake) that produces a score and tags each request into one of three bands: Self-Serve, Concierge, Enterprise Project.
- Self-Serve: requests that match existing dashboards/exports/short queries; automated response with runbook and template. SLA: 2 business days for guidance.
- Concierge: custom dashboard templates, slices >100GB or cross-workspace exports, or requests requiring schema mapping. Assigned to Solutions Eng / Analytics PO. SLA: scope within 5 business days, deliverables within 15-30 business days depending on size. Cost estimate and billing flag captured at scope.
- Enterprise Project: multi-month ingestion, GDPR/data residency work, or requests requiring platform changes (new aggregation, retention changes). Requires Sales/CS + Eng kickoff, contract amendment. SLA: kickoff in 5 business days, project plan within 10 business days.

Key components to deliver:
1) Intake form (hosted in Console + public support form) with gating questions and automatic score + tags.
2) Routing rules in Zendesk/Helpdesk to map tags to assigned queues (Ops, Solutions Eng, Sales).
3) Concierge SLA playbook + templated scoping checklist and cost-estimate calculator.
4) Self-serve kit: documented dashboards, export templates, query snippets, and runbook.
5) Telemetry to measure volume by band, conversion to paid engagements, SLA attainment, and mean time to resolution.
6) Billing flag & cost-estimate workflow to ensure Finance is aware of any non-standard deliverables.

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Intake form live in Console and public support doc; scoring algorithm implemented server-side.
- Routing configured: >=90% of tagged requests correctly assigned to intended queue during 2-week pilot.
- Concierge playbook and templates published in Confluence and linked in intake auto-reply.
- Instrumentation: dashboards show volume by band, avg time to scope, and conversion rate to paid work.

Success metrics (90 days post-launch):
- 40% reduction in average time from request to initial scope for high-touch requests.
- 30% fewer misrouted tickets to Eng.
- >20% of Concierge requests convert to a paid engagement (contract/committed spend).

Open questions / considerations:
- How granular should the scoring thresholds be vs. manual override by CS?
- What default pricing bands do we present for Concierge work vs. requiring pre-sales quote?
- Should we surface an estimated cost at intake or only after scoping call?
- Edge cases around PII-sensitive exports requiring Legal/Privacy approval; where to gate those?

Stakeholders:
- Product: Aisha Patel (owner), Marco Nguyen (assignee), Lina Ortega (Console PM)
- Eng: Infra Eng lead (Ravi Sharma), Solutions Eng (Priya Kaur)
- GTM: Sales AE (Jonas Reed), CS Director (Emilia Park), Finance (Diane Cook)
- Security & Privacy: Legal (Nate Hollis)

Rollout plan (phased):
- Phase 0 (2 weeks): Design intake form, scoring rubric, and routing matrix.
- Phase 1 (4 weeks): Build intake page + backend scoring, configure helpdesk routing, publish self-serve kit. Pilot with 5 mid-market accounts.
- Phase 2 (4 weeks): Launch concierge playbook, instrument metrics, train CS/Sales.
- Phase 3 (ongoing): Iterate thresholds, add automated cost estimator, explore productizing some Concierge templates.
